subject: System Design
title: Databases: The Persistence Layer
description: A 60-second lesson on Databases: The Persistence Layer.

hook.text: Servers are stateless — they forget everything after each request. Databases remember.

buildup.text: Databases store data durably so it survives server restarts, crashes, and deployments.

discovery.text: Relational databases use tables and SQL. NoSQL databases use documents, key-value pairs, or graphs.

twist.text: Choosing the wrong database for your workload is one of the hardest mistakes to fix later.

climax.text: The database is the heart of most systems. Everything else can be replaced more easily.

punchline.text: Pick the right database — it's the hardest to change.

quiz.question: Why is the database choice so critical?
options: It's the hardest component to replace later
